## Phase 4 contract graph

Plans expire after `1800` seconds. Executor leases expire after `60` seconds and check in every `20` seconds.

### Run transitions

- `interrupted` → `cancelled`
- `interrupted` → `running`
- `queued` → `cancelled`
- `queued` → `running`
- `running` → `failed`
- `running` → `interrupted`
- `running` → `partial`
- `running` → `succeeded`
